description: Flag a repeated-deviation signal when a second confirmed QC deviation event occurs within 72 hours of a related one, indicating the same issue is recurring rather than a one-off.

Elevate to a supplier-linked-pattern signal once two or more confirmed QC deviation events accumulate within a 30-day window, indicating a cross-batch pattern worth investigating against a shared supplier lot (subject to human confirmation of the shared lot itself).
Flag an escalating-backlog signal once two or more exception cases are open at the same time, indicating held/undispositioned output is accumulating rather than clearing.
Open a root-cause-investigation action item whenever a supervisor formally requests one.
